issue.title: Freshness mark: a concise, live rendering of [fresh::] stamps
issue.description: Every canonical `[fresh:: YYYY-MM-DD]` stamp renders in Obsidian as a small, theme-native freshness mark (`✓ today`, a draining lease ring with its age, `⟳ 9d` when due). The mark agrees exactly with the review queue wherever it shows a review state, and the stored syntax, both implementations, and every stamping path stay unchanged.
